principles: Rule engine is authoritative; presentation never re-implements legality.
Game data, UI semantics, layout, motion and skin are separate packages.
No DOM/CSS/JavaScript/Unity/Godot identifiers appear in canonical contracts.
Coordinates are normalized reference-space anchors; renderer chooses native layout implementation.
All user-visible text is localization-key based; no text is baked into generic UI artwork.
All reusable graphic primitives ship as SVG source plus transparent PNG fallback.
Card artwork and skins are replaceable content packs and cannot change gameplay contracts.
